back: Moving employees between different jobs at the same level to reduce boredom and build skills.
Adding more tasks of a similar level to a job: a wider job.
Adding responsibility, planning and decision making to a job: a deeper job.
Giving employees authority and resources to make decisions about their own work.
A small group of employees from the same area who meet regularly to find and solve quality problems.
Works councils or workers' committees, suggestion schemes, quality circles and worker directors.
If managers do not listen or act on suggestions, workers lose interest and motivation falls.
Team working, recognition, status, good working conditions, training and promotion.
Unfair pay can cancel the effect of job redesign and recognition (Herzberg: pay is a hygiene factor).
